This folder contains a script to grab and verify the 3rd party library SDL3 (joystick + sensor subsystems only).

The license file for that library is present for your convenience (and the convenience of any license scanning
tools you use), in the `SDL3` subfolder of this folder.

During the build process, the downloaded library will be copied into the build folder, under `_deps`, so as not to
pollute your source tree.
